text: Read the following case and answer the questions below The Italian government established the National Construction and Civil Services Development Board (CCSDB) in 1999, and began working to develop the industrial sector through   industry- Government partnerships. The government and CCSDB hope to establish organizations that are needed by companies, engineers, and skilled workers with regard to human resource development, technological innovation, and capital cooperation. These activities are expected to ensure a level of capacity building that will allow Italy to compete in global = economic structures. The Government is pursuing public private partnership (PPP), which introduces private sector funds into infrastructure building in Italy. Although the construction industry in Italy is relatively young, it has shown a rapid growth Js since the early 1970s. In the period of 1996 to 1999, construction works were sharply reduced due to the recent economic crisis, but went on the upswing from 1999 to 2005. j Brooks International, a construction company in Italy ,previously one of the fastest growing company in Italy ran ground aground in the late 2017 . Annual revenue growth which was previously 20 percent in the mid 2015 slowed to around 8 percent. New construction businesses entered in the market bringing in intense competition for Brooks. Amid competition and lowering of business revenues, Annie Sarah , founder of Brooks International stepped down as a CEO in 2017 after numerous attempts to revive the growth of the company. John Gill , an executive from French Giant IGL Construction Works cameo n Board as the CEO. However problems persisted despite the management change. In the fiscal year 2018, revenue grew to 13 percent but the profit before tax declined to 21 percent. Nonetheless, John was confident that a newly implemented marketing strategy would produce improved results. Suppose the founder of the company Annie Sarah came to you in 2019 for assistant in the near-term and long range planning for Brooks Internals. As a foundation for this work, you will need to estimate the future earnings and financial needs since Annie sarah is a strong willed decision maker with little taste for finance and financial jargon, Your projections must not only be technically correct but also yield practical insights and be straightforward. You are required to prepare financial projections of Brooks International by constructing the financial statements consisting of the Balance Sheet and Income statement for the year 2019-2020 based on the projections as provided below. All figures are in Euros. Sales: 422,70,000 Cost of Goods sold : 35 percent of sales Operating expenses: 50 percent of sales Interest expenses : 6 percent of Debt Profit before tax : Sales - COGS- Operating expenses —interest Corporate tax @ 30 percent of profit before tax Dividend : 1,20,000 Earnings retained : Profit after tax Current Assets : 32 percent of sales Fixed assets: 110,60,000 Total assets : Fixed assets + Current assets Current liabilities : 28 percent of sales Debt : Total assets-current liabilities — shareholders funds Equity : 1,21,60,000 Reserves : 52,00,000

text: Read the following case and answer the questions _ below: Failures has been transpired in the construction industry not only in developing countries but worldwide. Construction company failurés are not only extremely disruptive to the industry but it may pose a threat to the economy of the nation. Construction companies are vulnerable to bankruptcy due to fluctuations in construction volume, fragmented nature of the industry, inflation high competitien, the uncertainty and the risk involve. The earliest determination of any potential failure will protect the company from becoming a victim. Construction Industries in Developing countries like India has been undergoing transformation due to huge volume of construction activities since 1990. This has led to an escalating of construction companies and Large and ye complex projects has been constructed, these, cause an attraction of contractors and construction companies from all over the world. Thereby, construction companies are the backbone of real estate development. The booming of this industry is as a result of the wealth generated oil and gas sales, which is reinvested in infrastructure. Since the construction companies are the agent of transformation and development, they play a major role in national economy by using oil and gas wealth to construct economic and social facilities. However, thousands of these companies are facing bankruptcy and business failure, every year, and resulting in uncompleted private and public construction projects. The economic and social damages resulting from the business failure of construction companies are beyond the quantifiable costs to the company owners, share-holders creditors and employees [6]. Therefore, it’s important to recognize business failure at the earliest stage in order to reduce the economic damages. A periodic evaluation of the financial records of the company is a critical step in successful completion of a project, so that necessary and appropriate strategies can be put in place to maintain their survival. ‘As a Finance manager of IJL Construction Company, you are asked to assess the financial performance by ratio analysis from the following details with reference to the specified standard industry ratios with that of IJL Construction Company.
